title: SAFEMA Upholds PMLA Attachment in Gold Loan Fraud; Grants Relief for Court Deposit
description: SAFEMA Tribunal upheld PMLA attachment in an alleged gold loan fraud but set aside attachment of the ₹50 lakh court security deposit.The post SAFEMA Upholds PMLA Attachment in Gold Loan Fraud; Grants Relief for Court Deposit appeared first on TaxGuru.
